title: Phishing & Social Engineering Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional template to report phishing attacks and social engineering attempts to organizations. Protect yourself and others from scams.
description: Use this template to formally report phishing attacks, social engineering attempts, or suspicious communications to organizations, employers, or authorities. Help protect yourself and others by documenting security incidents properly.

sections.heading: Letter Header
sections.content:
[Your Name]
[Your Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]
[Email Address]
[Phone Number]
[Date]

[Recipient Name/Security Team]
[Organization Name]
[Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]

sections.heading: Subject and Opening
sections.content:
Subject: Report of Phishing/Social Engineering Attempt - Immediate Attention Required

Dear [Security Team/Recipient Name],

I am writing to report a suspected phishing attack and/or social engineering attempt that I recently encountered. I believe this incident poses a security risk and requires your immediate attention to protect [the organization/other potential victims].

sections.heading: Incident Details
sections.content:
**Incident Information:**
- Date and Time: [Date and time of incident]
- Type of Attack: [Phishing email/phone call/text message/website/social media]
- Suspected Source: [Email address, phone number, website URL, or social media account]
- Target Information: [What information was requested - passwords, personal data, financial information, etc.]

**Description of the Incident:**
[Provide a detailed description of what happened, including the communication method used, what the attacker claimed, and what action they requested you to take.]

placeholders.label: Detailed Description
placeholders.defaultValue: Received an email claiming to be from IT support requesting password reset

sections.heading: Evidence and Documentation
sections.content:
**Evidence Preserved:**
- Screenshots of suspicious communications (attached)
- Original email headers (if applicable)
- URLs of suspicious websites (if applicable)
- Phone numbers used in the attempt
- Any other relevant documentation

**Actions Taken:**
- Did not respond to or click any links in the suspicious communication
- Did not provide any personal or sensitive information
- Preserved evidence by taking screenshots
- Used secure browsing tools like Incognito Browser to investigate safely
- [Any other protective actions taken]

placeholders.label: Actions You Took
placeholders.defaultValue: Did not respond, preserved evidence, reported incident

sections.heading: Request for Action
sections.content:
**Requested Actions:**
I respectfully request that your organization:

1. Investigate this security incident thoroughly
2. Alert other [employees/customers/members] about this threat
3. Implement additional security measures if necessary
4. Provide guidance on how to handle similar future incidents
5. Confirm receipt of this report and any follow-up actions planned

**Urgency:** I believe this matter requires urgent attention as other individuals may be targeted by the same threat.

placeholders.label: Additional Requests
placeholders.defaultValue: Please investigate and notify other potential targets

sections.heading: Contact Information and Closing
sections.content:
I am available for any additional questions or to provide further information about this incident. Please feel free to contact me at [phone number] or [email address].

Thank you for your prompt attention to this security matter. I look forward to your response and any recommendations you may have for preventing similar incidents in the future.

Sincerely,
[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Your Title/Position, if applicable]

useCases: Reporting phishing emails to your employer's IT security team
Alerting banks or financial institutions about fraudulent communications
Notifying social media platforms about fake accounts or scams
Reporting phone-based social engineering attempts to authorities
Documenting suspicious websites for law enforcement
Alerting educational institutions about student-targeted scams
Reporting business email compromise attempts to company security
